question: Walking at (2)/(7) of his normal speed, Abhijeet is 70 minutes late in reaching.The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Speed ratio (New : Normal) = 2 : 7

Since **distance is constant**, Time ratio (New : Normal) = 7 : 2

Difference in time ratio parts = 7 − 2 = 5 units

5 units = 70 minutes → 1 unit = 14 minutes

Normal time = 2 units = 2 × 14 minutes = 28 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 28 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b43dba097b87c055d35f37f20a72cd9d6c8af2aa3cfe1dc1927abcf9388718a8.png] 
**Given:**

New Speed (Sₙ) = 2/7 of Normal Speed (Sᵤ)

Time delay = 70 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

If Distance is constant, Speed ∝ 1/Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Normal speed be 7x and Normal time be T.

⇒ New speed = 2x

⇒ Since Distance = Speed × Time:

⇒ 7x × T = 2x × (T + 70)

⇒ 7T = 2T + 140

⇒ 5T = 140

⇒ T = 140 ÷ 5

⇒ T = 28 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 28 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion Rule

When the distance is constant, the ratio of speeds is the inverse of the ratio of time taken: S₁/S₂ = T₂/T₁.

Late/Early Concept

If a person is late by 'L' and early by 'E', the total time difference is L + E. If both are late or both are early, the difference is |L − E|.

Average Speed

For the same distance covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).</p
